_doc: #387 — the WEAPON SHAPE parity fixture: the exact cell set one strike touches. ONE file, TWO readers —
packages/fight/test/weapon_shapes.test.js drives the JS twin through the real preview path
SAME vectors through combat_grid::zone_cells. A divergence breaks one of them, by construction.
Geometry: cell = y*20 + x (GRID_W 20, GRID_H 19). Attacker at (5,5)=105, aimed cell east at (6,5)=106, so
the strike axis is +x and the perpendicular bar is +/-y (away_dir ties break to x, both twins).
106 = the aimed cell   107 = one cell beyond (+x)   105 = the attacker's own cell
`zones`      — ENGINE truth. A zone kind resolves to a cell set. Content's sealed vocabulary names each
kind; the engine speaks the (area_shape, area_size) pair the spell zone engine already
uses. This layer is code-owned and fully asserted on both twins.
`categories` — the BUILT-IN DEFAULT assignment (the owner's #387 final ruling), which published catalog
data overrides per template. Assignments are content, not engine — see weapon_shapes.js.
#387 leg 1 (design word 2026-08-04): the ranged BAND FLOOR is a per-category ruling authored on the zone
row — bow 2, wand 2, spellbook 1 (the donor corpus: n=529, 98% min-2). The two `range_min` rows below moved
1 -> 2 with that ruling; every other row of this file is untouched.
